description:
Cast The Trickster God's Heist by paying {2}{U}{B}, putting a lore counter on it as it enters and causing its first chapter ability to trigger.
Resolve the chapter ability, exchanging control of a creature an opponent controls and Old Fat Spider.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Old Fat Spider.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
